statement: BTOS AI-use share in 2027Q4 is < 1.5x its 2025 average (Bloc A Census BTOS; 2027Q4)
status_at_phase_end: Data gap. The source survey (BTOS) had only just started (biweekly collection from mid-July 2022, first data release 2022-10-13) and had published no AI-use estimate. The only official firm-level AI-adoption measure was the 2018 Annual Business Survey technology module, which found advanced-technology (incl. AI) adoption rare and concentrated in large, older firms.

items.summary: Bloc A's statistics agency announced the new biweekly business survey (successor to its pandemic small-business pulse survey), with data collection scheduled to begin mid-July 2022 and release via the experimental data products site; the announcement describes business-conditions topics, not AI use.
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau Bloc A Counts story, 'Business Trends and Outlook Survey: New Light on Business Health' (page title 'BTOS Expands Small Business Pulse Survey, Will Conduct Continuous Data Collection'), 2022-06-23 (verified via web_extract this run). Federal Register notice seeking comment 2021-11-09.

items.summary: The survey's first data release was 2022-10-13; at phase end it had about two and a half months of published data and no AI-use estimate (the first AI-use story listed on the survey's data page is dated well after the window).
items.detail: Census BTOS data page (verified via web_extract this run): 'Initial Release Date October 13, 2022'; stories list shows 'How Many Bloc A. Businesses Use Artificial Intelligence?' dated 2023-11-28 as the earliest AI item. Current page version (post-dates phase) used only for the static release date and to confirm absence of an as-of AI series.

items.summary: The only official firm-level AI-adoption baseline then available (2018 Annual Business Survey, >850,000 firms) found digitisation widespread but advanced-technology adoption including AI rare and skewed toward larger, older firms, so worker exposure exceeded firm-level adoption.
items.detail: Zolas et al., 'Advanced Technologies Adoption and Use by Bloc A. Firms: Evidence from the Annual Business Survey', NBER Working Paper 28290, issue date December 2020 (verified via web_extract this run; abstract only, AI share number not read). Day of month not shown; set to 2020-12-01. (month-only date)
items.value: AI adoption 'rare' (2018 ABS; exact share not read)
